query: INSERT INTO sync_mappings (series_id, provider, external_id) SELECT DISTINCT ON (series_id) series_id, $1, external_id FROM UNNEST($2::uuid[], $3::text[]) WITH ORDINALITY AS t(series_id, external_id, ord) ORDER BY series_id, ord DESC ON CONFLICT (series_id, provider) DO UPDATE SET external_id = EXCLUDED.external_id, updated_at = now()
